CMPUT 174: Introduction to the Foundations of Computation I
Fall 2026 Course Outline
Department of Computing Science, University of Alberta
Instructor: [Department Staff]
Contact: [cs-undergrad-advising@ualberta.ca]

Course Description:
CMPUT 174 introduces fundamental principles of programming and problem solving using Python. Topics include abstraction, state, control flow, functions, testing, and algorithmic decomposition.
